FN-2G3GSS-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 422
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Tim Wadsworth
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/08/2023
House Bill 422as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund, increase
receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general funds, and other
funds to which court costs are deposited, dependent upon the number of persons charged with
and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
In addition, this bill could increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Law
Enforcement Agency and the Department of Conservation and Natural Resources to notify the
public of the requirements and prohibitions provided by this bill.
Page 1

FN-2G3GSS-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 422
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Representative Tim Wadsworth
Economic Development
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/23/2023
House Bill 422 as passed the House of Representatives could increase receipts to the State
General Fund, increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal
general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited, by an undetermined amount
dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by
this bill and the penalties imposed.
In addition, this bill could increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Law
Enforcement Agency and the Department of Conservation and Natural Resources to notify the
public of the requirements and prohibitions provided by this bill.
